title: How the Sabboth of the New Testament is to be obserued?

segments.text:
Ans. In obseruing a Sabboth of the new Testament, there are two things required; a Rest, and a Sanctification of the same rest to an holy vse. This Answer is made out of the very substance of the fourth Commandement, which is morall, and hath nothing ceremoniall in it. And the fourth Commandement (for substance) consists in a ceasing frō labour, and a holy dedication of our rest to holy vse, that is, to the worship and seruice
of God.
